ledger.note: 528: the Huns are driven out. Alchon Huns page: 'Mihirakula was defeated in 528 by an alliance of Indian principalities led by Yasodharman' (the Sondani inscription records the victory 'in 528 CE'; the page ends the Second Hunnic War 'in c. 534'); Gupta Empire page: 'The Huns were defeated and driven out of India in 528' by Yashodharman and possibly Narasimhagupta. The Yashodharman page: his Sondani pillar (samvat 589 = 532) records 'the submission by force of the Hunas'; he took much of the Gupta territory to the east. The occupation is closed at 528, the year both pages give for the defeat; alchon-huns /ledger/16 and white-huns /ledger/10 close theirs at 534, the page's end of the war (disagreement recorded in the notes). Bhanugupta at Eran in 510: 'defeated Toramana' (Gupta page) against 'suffered severe casualties' (Alchon page).

Names the gazetteer lacks and that are used only in text or capitals: Kausambi, Eran, Ahichchhatra, Padmavati.
